sections.title: The problem
sections.html:
The problem

What it is there to fix.

Trap days leave thin records

What happened on site is written up afterwards from memory and loose notes, which weakens the case at trial.

Sanction requests stall

Prosecution sanction sits with an authority for months and nobody is tracking the clock until it is too late.

Assets are checked separately

Disproportionate assets analysis runs as its own exercise, disconnected from the trap case it belongs to.

sections.title: How it works
sections.html:
How it works

From input to outcome.

  1. ComplaintBribe demand complaint recorded
  2. VerifyDemand confirmed; recording checked
  3. PlanTeam, witnesses, note serial numbers
  4. TrapChemical test, seizure and arrest logged on site
  5. ProsecuteSanction request, chargesheet, court tracking
